title: HyperVAttention: Efficient Sparse Attention with Spatio-Temporal Clustering for Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2607.03012v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) have demonstrated significant capabilities in high-fidelity video generation. However, their ability to produce long-duration videos is fundamentally constrained by the quadratic complexity of the self-attention mechanism. Recent clustering-based sparse attention methods improve the quality-speed trade-off by grouping semantically similar tokens, but their practical efficiency remains limited by two bottlenecks: substantial clustering overhead and low CTA utilization caused by irregular cluster-induced blocks. We propose HyperVAttention (HVA), a training-free sparse attention framework that addresses both bottlenecks jointly. To reduce clustering overhead, we introduce 3D local-window clustering, which exploits the spatio-temporal locality of video tokens to restrict centroid search to fixed local neighborhoods, and implement it with a custom Triton kernel for efficient execution. translated_title: HyperVAttention：基于时空聚类的高效稀疏注意力方法用于视频扩散
translated_abstract: 视频扩散Transformer（VDiTs）在高保真视频生成方面展现出了卓越的能力。然而，其生成长时长视频的能力从根本上受到自注意力机制二次方复杂度的制约。近期基于聚类的稀疏注意力方法通过将语义相似的token分组来改善质量与速度的权衡，但其实际效率仍受两个瓶颈的限制：可观的聚类开销，以及由不规则聚类块导致的低CTA利用率。我们提出了HyperVAttention（HVA），这是一个无需训练的稀疏注意力框架，可同时解决上述两个瓶颈。为降低聚类开销，我们引入了3D局部窗口聚类，利用视频token的时空局部性将质心搜索限制在固定的局部邻域内，并通过自定义Triton内核实现高效执行。我们进一步……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HyperVAttention——一种无需训练的稀疏注意力框架，通过3D局部窗口聚类和自定义Triton内核，同时降低视频扩散Transformer的聚类开销并提升CTA利用率，实现高效的长视频生成加速。
